# Vizamigo

> Global Mobility, Visa Intelligence & Smart Passport Travel Assistant.
> Up-to-date entry regulations, dual passport comparison, Schengen 90/180 tracker, and digital nomad guides for 199 countries.

Vizamigo provides travelers, digital nomads, and global citizens with verified border policies, visa exemptions, and diplomatic crisis assistance.

## Supported Languages

- [Türkçe (Turkish)](https://www.vizamigo.com/tr): 199 ülke vize rejimleri, çifte pasaport gücü, Schengen sayacı ve seyahat rehberi.
- [English](https://www.vizamigo.com/en): Global visa regimes, dual passport synergy, Schengen 90/180 calculator, and travel guides.
- [Deutsch (German)](https://www.vizamigo.com/de): Weltweite Visabestimmungen, Doppelpass-Synergie, Schengen-Rechner und Reiseführer.
- [Español (Spanish)](https://www.vizamigo.com/es): Regímenes de visado global, sinergia de doble pasaporte, calculadora Schengen y guías.
- [Русский (Russian)](https://www.vizamigo.com/ru): Глобальный визовый режим, сила двух паспортов, калькулятор Шенген и гиды.

## Core Travel Intelligence Tools

- [Route & Dual Passport Planner (TR)](https://www.vizamigo.com/tr/plan): Çifte pasaport mukayesesi ve çok ülkeli rota planlayıcı.
- [Route & Dual Passport Planner (EN)](https://www.vizamigo.com/en/plan): Compare passport strengths and plan multi-country itineraries.
- [Schengen 90/180 Day Calculator (TR)](https://www.vizamigo.com/tr/track): Kayan pencere kuralına göre kalan yasal kalış süresi sayacı.
- [Schengen 90/180 Day Calculator (EN)](https://www.vizamigo.com/en/track): Rolling window stay tracker for Schengen zone entries and exits.
- [Digital Nomad Visas Guide (TR)](https://www.vizamigo.com/tr/nomad): Uzaktan çalışma gelir şartları, başvuru süreleri ve vergi rehberi.
- [Digital Nomad Visas Guide (EN)](https://www.vizamigo.com/en/nomad): Remote work minimum income requirements, tax rules, and application steps.
- [Traveler Profile & Emergency Desk (TR)](https://www.vizamigo.com/tr/profile): Diplomatik kriz masası, kayıp pasaport ve konsolosluk acil yardım hattı.
- [Traveler Profile & Emergency Desk (EN)](https://www.vizamigo.com/en/profile): Consular emergency desk, lost passport hotline, and traveler wallet.
